cards.name: Zoom - wobble
cards.summary: Master control of the 'Zoom - wobbling' transition preset (Transitions - Movement): as Transition Completion goes 0 -> 100 a Transform effect scales the layer up from 0 to 100 % while its Skew, Skew Axis and Rotation unwind from Wobble Amount-based angles to 0, so the layer grows in with a sheared, swirling wobble and lands flat. Linear mapping, no elastic overshoot or bounce.
use_for: wobbly pop-in of a photo card, meme or reaction image in a satire or social reel
playful entrance of a sticker, logo or emoji plate in an explainer
reverse (100 -> 0) to shrink and wobble a card out before the next beat
avoid: adding the control by match name and expecting motion: on its own it is only sliders and changes no pixels
serious documentary, news-of-record or condolence/obituary content: the skew wobble reads playful and cheap
using it on every cut; once per section at most
Wobble Amount above 70: Transform Skew clamps at 70, so the shear stops growing while the rotation keeps scaling

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: 0 = scale 0 (invisible), skew/rotation at full wobble; 100 = full size, unskewed, upright. Keyframe it; the default 50 freezes a half-size, skewed layer
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 over 0.5-0.8 s with easing (or 100 -> 0 for an exit)

params.name: Wobble Amount
params.does: angle in degrees: start Skew = Wobble Amount, start Skew Axis = 6 x Wobble Amount (one full 360-degree axis sweep at the default 60), start Rotation = -Wobble Amount; all unwind to 0
params.typical: 30-60 (60 = preset default; keep at or below 70)

cards.equivalent: Premiere: none built in; recreate with the Transform effect (keyframe Scale 0 -> 100, Skew 60 -> 0, Skew Axis 360 -> 0, Rotation -60 -> 0). Cross Zoom is only a crude substitute
cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control sliders defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; Wobble Amount is an Angle control), not a renderer: addProperty('ADBE CM ZoomWobble') only adds the sliders and changes NO pixels. To get the look, open the comp, select ONLY the target layer, then layer.applyPreset(new File('C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Movement/Zoom - wobbling.ffx')) (note the preset file is 'Zoom - wobbling', the control is 'Zoom - wobble'); the preset adds this control plus a Transform effect, then keyframe 'Transition Completion'. Expressions address the control by its display name ('Zoom - wobble'), so never rename the effect. Verified from the preset: Transform Scale = linear(TC, 0, 100, 0, 100); Skew = linear(TC, 0, 100, Wobble, 0); Skew Axis = linear(TC, 0, 100, Wobble * 6, 0); Rotation = linear(TC, 0, 100, -Wobble, 0). Mapping is linear, so ease the keyframes. For motion blur, untick the Transform's 'Use Composition's Shutter Angle' and set its Shutter Angle (e.g. 180).

verified.note: Card status is 'hidden' (pseudo-effect slider control that changes no pixels on its own), so it was not rendered: no entry in gallery/ae/index.json or failed.json.
